subject: Technical kickoff and calendar alignment for MediSys private deployment
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Technical kickoff and calendar alignment for MediSys private deployment

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a proposal for next steps so we can get a technical deep-dive on the calendar.

What we covered
- High-level constraints: air-gapped requirement for test environment, private VPC connectivity to their on-prem data lake, and compliance windows for data residency.
- Expected QPS: 60 concurrent requests at 512-token avg; burst to 250 qps during batch jobs.
- Primary goals: predictable latency (<150ms p95 token), audit logging, and customer-managed keys.

Proposed next step
- 60-minute architecture review + demo of a representative end-to-end flow (model serving, KV cache behavior, network requirements).
- Suggested attendees: your infra/security lead, our runtime/ops engineer (Dev), and Naomi from CS for rollout planning.

Available slots (PT)
- Tue 8 Dec, 10:00–11:00
- Tue 8 Dec, 14:00–15:00
- Wed 9 Dec, 09:00–10:00

Please pick any slot that works via this Calendly link (or propose another): https://calendly.com/redwood/privdeploy-technical-dive?month=dec-2026

Attachments: discovery-notes-20261204.pdf (summary of today's discovery; shown as attachment below) and a short scope worksheet I filled out with the items we discussed.

Open questions for prep (we can collect these ahead of the meeting)
- Preferred KMS/HSM provider and whether keys will be managed by MediSys or Redwood in Private deployment.
- Expected dataset sizes and whether synthetic datasets are acceptable for the demo.
- Any narrow networking constraints (e.g., mandatory proxying, IP whitelists).

If you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite + pre-call checklist (networking diagram + service account perms) so your infra/security team can validate.

Thanks — look forward to the next step.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Rafael —

Thanks for the summary and the slot options. Tue 8 Dec, 14:00–15:00 PT works best for us.

Can we add our network/security lead, Chris Lee (cc'd here), to the call? He'll want to review the VPC peering and data flow diagrams. Also copying a partner at BrightCare (Tom Hsu) who will join to confirm downstream integrations.

About the prep items: we manage keys internally (AWS KMS) and can provide a staging dataset (PII removed) for the demo. I'll upload a basic network topology after Chris reviews; should be available by Monday.

See you on Tue.

— Anita

Prep items I'll own:
- Bring a short demo that starts with a 256-token prompt, then runs a 2k-token retrieval + generation flow to show KV caching impact.
- Prepare a one-slide network checklist for Chris (eg required ports, IP ranges, proxy notes).
- Bring a fallback plan: show a smaller quantized variant if their staging GPUs can't run FP16 in the demo.

What I need from you:
